review_limitations: Credential and private-data detection is heuristic. Passing these checks is evidence of the performed review, not a guarantee that every possible unknown or encoded secret can be detected.
Metadata checks inspect image headers and recognized metadata fields; they do not manually interpret the visible pixels of every artwork or screenshot.

The three documented historical PNG masters are already truncated in the original Git data and cannot complete full image verification. They are retained byte-for-byte for provenance and are not current runtime assets.
ZIP checks verify retained inner asset archives. Integrity verification of the final downloadable export archives is recorded separately after those archives are created.
The final generated file inventories contain paths, sizes, checksums and source-comparison statuses; they are produced after this scoped scan and are included in the final archive verification.
